headline: Steelers traded Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys
detail: Dallas sent a 2028 second-round pick and a 2027 sixth-round pick. Porter was already ruled out for Pittsburgh's Thursday game at Cleveland, listed not injury related / conditioning / back. He had not played in the first three weeks. Pittsburgh's corner group without him is Jalen Ramsey, Jamel Dean, Asante Samuel Jr., Brandin Echols, and Daylen Everette. Dallas corner Cobie Durant is dealing with a hamstring and did not practice Wednesday. Porter is not an automatic Week 4 starter in Dallas.
desk: Do not count Porter as a Steelers corner. Do not count him as an active Cowboy until he is on the Dallas injury or inactive list. Tonight's Steelers card was already without him.
